role: Conceptual illustrated atlas backgrounds. Labels, lesson links and curriculum relationships are rendered separately in SVG.

prompts.world: Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE exquisitely detailed original illustrated atlas landscape for Primer, a knowledge-learning application. Wide landscape aspect ratio 3:2, highest available resolution, preferably 3072x2048. This is the text-free artwork layer for a zoomable knowledge map. A SINGLE UNIFIED atlas panorama on pale warm ivory paper, engraved pen-and-ink linework with beautiful restrained watercolor shading, jade/teal, ochre, terracotta, indigo. Think a premium natural history atlas crossed with a lovingly illustrated map of human knowledge. No frames, no panel boxes, no cards, no writing or labels whatsoever; live labels will be overlaid. Deliberately arranged distinct regions connected by fine flowing ink paths and gentle terrain transitions: UPPER LEFT a mathematical workshop with geometric solids, compass, curves, tessellations becoming an elegant computation tree, logic gates and a processor; UPPER RIGHT a natural world landscape with a large cutaway planet, stars and planetary orbits above, prism and wave forms, crystal structures and ball-and-stick molecule clusters, a detailed plant, DNA helix and cutaway cell. LOWER RIGHT an applied science landscape with bridge trusses, waterwheel and machines, a greenhouse and farm roots, architectural building cutaway, medical imaging gantry as symbolic instrument. LOWER CENTER a humanities and society landscape with archaeological strata and amphora, civic architecture, scales, books, a human head silhouette with neural branches, schools and community gathering; LOWER LEFT an artistic landscape with musical instruments, paint pigments, manuscript, feather pen, theatre and a camera. Open ivory central space about 18% of image for an overlay title/compass. Leave breathable pale pockets beside every major illustration for live explanatory labels. Main drawings must be large and richly shaded, small supporting drawings form real connected visual explanations. Flat top-down illustration / gentle axonometric scientific drawing, not photoreal, not fantasy, no impossible architecture, no people closeups, no monsters. No text, no digits, no fake formulae, no watermarks. Original composition. Consistent thin ink outlines with precise natural forms, full page polished educational poster quality.
prompts.formal:
Create one ORIGINAL premium illustrated knowledge-atlas landscape for Primer. Landscape aspect ratio 3:2, maximum native resolution. Unified connected composition across pale warm ivory paper, extraordinarily detailed engraved ink with rich restrained watercolor shading in jade, teal, ochre, terracotta, indigo. Large beautiful explanatory objects with smaller supporting details, like a fine natural-history folio. No rectangular panels, no cards, no frame borders, no UI. NO text, letters, digits, labels, formulae or watermarks; these will be accurate SVG overlays. Leave breathable pale pockets between the main drawings and near the centre for labels. No photorealism. Depict real phenomena and plausible objects as an educational overview, not a technical measurement reference.
Formal sciences. Left half is MATHEMATICS: geometric solids, compass construction, tessellations, number-counting beads, coordinate curves without labels, tangent to a smooth curve, integral area shading, branching proof-like structures. Right half is COMPUTER SCIENCE: an algorithm decision tree, binary mosaic of unmarked filled/empty cells, an open mechanical calculating device and microchip, computer memory as stacked storage blocks, a network leading to neural layers. Shapes from geometry flow into computational diagrams via a continuous ribbon of fine ink. Lower middle an elegant tree whose roots are geometric constructions and branches are algorithms. Keep landmarks large, nuanced shading, no characters. Drawings span entire page with a balanced clear central gap.
